description: Agent Insurance: submit one policy’s limits with the stated exposure: the policy with its currency, the per-occurrence and aggregate limits as recorded and each sublimit with its category; the exposure with the category of loss it falls in, the stated exposure for one occurrence, its currency and description; each prior claim in the policy period with its id, what it paid and what is reserved against the aggregate, its date and category, as recorded; and optionally a contract with the contracting party, its currency and the per-occurrence, aggregate and category minimums it requires. The signed report gives the policy, the exposure, the limit one occurrence draws on as the lower of the per-occurrence limit and the sublimit on the exposure’s category with which one binds, the shortfall and the exposure’s share of the limit, the aggregate with the prior claims, the amount eroded, the amount left and the share used, and every contract minimum against the figure the policy holds, and counts them, and names short limits: a per-occurrence limit below the stated exposure, a sublimit that caps the exposure below it, an aggregate eroded below the exposure by prior claims, and limits under a contract’s required minimums; then an exposure at 90% or more of its limit, an aggregate half used or more and an exposure or contract stated in another currency, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No per-occurrence limit, no stated exposure, no exposure category where the policy has sublimits, no prior claims record or no aggregate where erosion or a contract needs one leaves the limits unverified. This reads one policy’s limits against the stated exposure: a counterparty’s certificate limits against required minimums read as diligence evidence are wever_insurance-evidence-check, an agent’s own spend caps are wever_exposure-cap-check and one planned action’s worst case against its limits is wever_risk-exposure-check. Verdict insurance_limits_short, insurance_limits_partial, insurance_limits_unverified or insurance_limits_sufficient. POST /api/insurance-limits-check. Reads the insurance records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment, claim filing, coverage binding or external write. Agent Insurance reads an insurance policy after the fact, from the subject’s own records: the coverage against the insured activity, the exclusions against the activity and its parts, the limits against the stated exposure, the deductible against what the buyer was told, the claims deadlines against an incident, a certificate against the policy it was issued from, incident notice under the policy and a renewal against the expiring policy. Beside it, wever_insurance-evidence-check reads a counterparty’s insurance certificate or policy excerpt as diligence evidence and reports what that material establishes against required coverages, limits and a work window, while an insurance check reads the subject’s own policy against a stated need, an incident or a certificate issued from it; wever_warranty-check reads a warranty claim against warranty terms, while an insurance check reads an insurance policy; and wever_risk-downside-check reads a planned action’s downside before it is taken, while an insurance check reads the policy behind it after the fact. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-insurance-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-insurance/.
